page_title: AK-47 Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the AK-47 marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Colombian × Mexican × Thai × Afghani
Breeder: Serious Seeds
THC Content: 18–25%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Caryophyllene , Limonene
Primary Flavors: Earthy, Sweet, Floral, Spicy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Early to Mid-October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–21 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Few cannabis cultivars carry a reputation as enduring as AK-47 . Despite the aggressive name, the strain delivers a surprisingly balanced experience that blends mental stimulation with a gentle physical calm. Created by Serious Seeds in the early 1990s, this hybrid quickly became a cornerstone of modern marijuana breeding thanks to its potency, complex aroma, and reliable growth characteristics.

Rather than overwhelming users with raw intensity, the plant produces a high that feels lively yet controlled. A mixture of tropical sativa heritage and Afghani indica stability gives the strain a distinctive personality—energizing at first, then gradually settling into comfortable relaxation. Over the decades, the cultivar has earned numerous cannabis awards and continues to appear in breeding projects worldwide, securing its place as one of the most recognized weed strains ever developed.
Genetics and Lineage

AK-47 was bred by Serious Seeds, a Dutch cannabis seed company known for producing stable, award-winning genetics. The strain combines four classic landrace varieties: Colombian, Mexican, Thai, and Afghani. Each of these parents contributes distinct characteristics that shape the final hybrid.

The Colombian and Mexican genetics introduce bright cerebral stimulation and energetic effects. Cannabis from these regions often carries uplifting qualities and expressive terpene profiles that lean toward citrus and spice. These influences provide the lively mental character that defines the early stages of the experience.

Thai genetics add complexity to both aroma and effect. Thai sativa plants are known for their stimulating highs and floral spice notes, which contribute to the strain’s layered fragrance. Meanwhile, the Afghani lineage anchors the hybrid with dense bud structure, strong resin production, and calming physical undertones. The combination of these four landrace backgrounds results in a plant that blends tropical energy with indica stability.
Effects and Experience

The effects often begin with a noticeable shift in mood. Shortly after inhalation, many cannabis consumers feel a wave of euphoria accompanied by heightened awareness. This early stage frequently brings a sense of mental clarity and enthusiasm that can transform ordinary activities into engaging experiences.

As the high progresses, cerebral stimulation becomes more pronounced. Thoughts tend to flow freely, which can lead to bursts of creativity or animated conversation. Social settings often feel more vibrant during this phase, and many enthusiasts enjoy the strain while spending time with friends or engaging in artistic pursuits.

Eventually, the experience transitions toward a calmer state. A gentle body relaxation spreads through the muscles without creating heavy sedation. Because the high evolves from energetic uplift to comfortable ease, the cultivar offers a balanced journey that appeals to both recreational cannabis users and those seeking a more functional weed experience.
Medical Benefits

The versatile nature of AK-47 has led many patients to explore its potential therapeutic uses . The uplifting mental effects may help counteract feelings of stress or emotional heaviness. By encouraging a brighter perspective, the strain can support individuals navigating challenging periods of daily life.

Another potential benefit involves mental focus and motivation. The stimulating cerebral influence may help some individuals maintain concentration during creative or intellectual tasks. This quality can make the strain appealing for those who prefer cannabis that enhances productivity rather than promoting inactivity.

While the strain is primarily known for its mental stimulation, the mild body relaxation that develops later in the experience may also assist with physical comfort. Some patients incorporate medical marijuana strains like this one into routines aimed at addressing minor aches or tension while still maintaining mental clarity.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

AK-47 presents a complex terpene profile that reflects its diverse genetic heritage. When a jar of cured buds is opened, the first impression often includes earthy spice combined with tangy citrus. A faint floral sweetness emerges beneath these dominant aromas, giving the fragrance a layered quality.

Breaking apart the flowers intensifies the scent. Myrcene contributes the earthy base that grounds the aroma, while limonene introduces bright citrus notes. Caryophyllene adds a peppery spice that creates depth and complexity. Together, these terpenes produce a fragrance that feels both warm and vibrant.

The flavor profile mirrors the aromatic experience. On the inhale, many people detect tangy citrus mixed with herbal sweetness. As the smoke leaves the palate, earthy spice and pine become more pronounced. The aftertaste often lingers pleasantly, leaving a subtle sweetness that complements the strain’s uplifting effects.
Growing Information

AK-47 gained popularity not only for its effects but also for its dependable cultivation traits. The plant tends to grow to a medium height with strong lateral branching. This structure allows the flowers to receive adequate light, encouraging even bud development throughout the canopy.

Indoor flowering typically completes within eight to nine weeks, which is relatively fast considering the plant’s sativa influence. During the flowering phase, buds form dense clusters that gradually become coated with thick trichomes. By the final weeks before harvest, the plant emits a strong citrus and spice aroma that signals the maturation of the terpene profile.

For cultivators planning to grow marijuana , maintaining good airflow and moderate humidity levels helps protect the dense flowers from moisture issues. The strain responds well to consistent feeding schedules and adequate lighting. When cultivated carefully, the plant produces impressive yields of resin-rich buds with strong visual appeal.
FAQ
What strain is AK-47? AK-47 is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Serious Seeds. It combines Colombian, Mexican, Thai, and Afghani landrace genetics.
How strong is AK-47 cannabis? THC levels typically range between 19% and 24%, making it a moderately strong to potent cannabis strain.
What does AK-47 taste like? The flavor profile often includes tangy citrus, herbal sweetness, earthy spice, and hints of pine.
Is AK-47 good for daytime use? Yes. The strain’s uplifting cerebral effects can make it suitable for daytime activities, although higher doses may feel more relaxing.
How long does the AK-47 high last? The effects generally last between two and three hours, beginning with mental stimulation before gradually transitioning into gentle physical relaxation.
Final Thoughts on AK-47

AK-47 stands as one of the most influential cannabis strains in modern breeding history. By blending four distinct landrace varieties, Serious Seeds created a hybrid capable of delivering potency, aromatic complexity, and balanced effects. The result is a marijuana cultivar that remains relevant decades after its introduction.

Part of the strain’s enduring appeal lies in the progression of its high. The experience begins with energetic mental uplift before gradually easing into comfortable physical calm. This transition allows the cultivar to serve both social and relaxing settings, giving it broad appeal among cannabis enthusiasts. Equally notable is the terpene profile. The mixture of citrus, spice, and earthy sweetness creates a distinctive aroma that reflects the strain’s diverse genetic heritage. These flavors often remain memorable long after the session ends.

Growers continue to appreciate the plant for its stability and resin production. Moderate flowering time, strong branching, and generous trichome coverage make it an attractive option for cultivators seeking dependable weed yields. Taken together, these characteristics explain why AK-47 has remained a cornerstone of cannabis culture . Its blend of uplifting effects, rich aroma, and reliable genetics ensures that it will continue to influence the world of marijuana for years to come.
